content:
**q07.**

`web/src/connect.ts`

All ConnectRPC service clients are created there from a single shared transport (`createConnectTransport` at `web/src/connect.ts:184`), then exported as module-level singletons — `instanceServiceClient`, `authServiceClient`, `userServiceClient`, `memoServiceClient`, `attachmentServiceClient`, `aiServiceClient`, `shortcutServiceClient`, `identityProviderServiceClient` (`web/src/connect.ts:192-203`).

One notable detail: the file also builds a *second*, separate transport and client — `refreshTransport` / `refreshAuthClient` (`web/src/connect.ts:65-72`) — used by the auth-refresh interceptor so token refresh doesn't recurse through the intercepted main transport.
